newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH SHARES SEEN LOSING STEAM AFTER WED JUMP.
newsitem.headline: POLISH SHARES SEEN LOSING STEAM AFTER WED JUMP.

text.p: Polish shares were seen losing steam or falling on Thursday after the previous session's 1.8-percent jump on Tuesday's surge by the Dow Jones industrial average.
Analysts said the strong selling after price-fixing on Wednesday, mixed continous trade then and the Dow's Wednesday fall, all pointed to a weaker market on Thursday.
Gauge maker Apator trade on the bourse's parallel floor on Thursday.
